why: DISCLOSED SURVIVOR. captureFrame copies the canvas without drawing first, so a press in a later task than the frame reads the cleared buffer of a renderer created without preserveDrawingBuffer, and the screenshot is blank. Vitest cannot reach createRenderer past its WebGLRenderer (rendering.md: renderer.ts is covered through the real-browser GL harness), so no Vitest test can kill it. tools/gl/harness.ts's 'captureFrame copies the game frame after it was presented, at the drawing-buffer size (issue #254)' check does: its canvas is presented before the capture.
